lines.en: : Are you sure you’re okay with doing this for me? Because I know it’s a pretty big ask.
: Ain’t nothin’ I haven't done a million times before. Don’t worry about it.
: Thank you, Yuki. And if there’s anything I can do to pay you back, let me know.
: I mean...you can literally pay me. That would work.
: If there is anything else I can do to pay you back, let me know.
: What’s going on? Sara trying to coerce sexual favors out of you again?
: Hah...no. I gave up on that months ago.
: No offense, Sensei. You’re an exceptional bedroom partner and I wouldn’t trade our moments of intimacy for the world...but Yuki is Yuki.
: There are simply some things a woman can do to another woman that a man would never be able to. And Yuki seems to have missed the memo that everyone is bisexual in 2020.
: You know, back in the old day, everyone wanted a piece of this. Now, no one does and it’s making me very self-conscious.
: Yo. You ain’t got shit going on tonight, do you? Could use some help with something.
: Is it the thing Sara just asked for your help with? Because I’m still not convinced it isn’t sexual.
: Just some work shit. Reason she’s bein’ all thankful is my shift already ended.
: And with the amount of money I’ve been pumping back into the business lately, I can’t really afford to pay Yuki overtime.
: What does she need to do exactly? Because I think you guys may have pushed the whole handing out fliers thing as far as it can go.
: Gotta go pick up some machine or whatever. Ain’t a problem. Moved plenty of shit back when I was a drifter.
: Isn’t Yuki the coolest? Like, who can actually say “back when I was a drifter” and be serious about it?
: It becomes a little less cool when you realize half of that shit probably didn’t belong to her and was pawned off so she could get high.
: Hey, there was other shit. I bought food too. And bike parts. You’re underestimating just how cheap drugs are, man.
: Would you mind going with her? I feel bad making Yuki lug a whole appliance all the way back here by herself.
: Ain’t like this guy’ll be much help. Might look kinda big, but I’ve run into plenty of guys even bigger than him who wound up being total fuckin’ pansies.
: I’ll go if Yuki promises to stop insulting me.
: What? It ain’t an insult if it’s the truth. If you’re gonna bring up the drugs, I’m gonna bring up how your bones are probably made out of marshmallows or some shit.
: Well, it sounds like my only choice is to tag along and show you just how much of a man I am.
: Just don’t show her too much or I will be very jealous! And remember that it takes significantly less to impress me!
: I am well aware, Sara. But thank you for reminding me.
: Ready to hit the road, then? Should get a move on now before it gets too late. Gotta go all the way downtown to pick this shit up.
: Downtown? But how are we going to-
: Follow me outside and I’ll show you.
Yuki didn’t get a car, did she?
The apartment is one thing — and a thing I was able to overlook for the most part seeing as it is not a very nice apartment.
But a car? In a city with cheap, functional public transportation? No wonder Sara isn’t able to pay her for overtime if her wage has gone up that much.
The two of us step outside of the bar as Sara slips back into work-mode and attempts to hold down the fort while her only other employee tonight is away.
But considering Yuki’s shift already ended, Sara probably knows-
: Wait, what the fuck is this?
: My pride and joy, obviously.
: Your pride and joy has double D’s and anger issues. This is a motorcycle.
: Why even ask if you already know what it is, fucker?
: Aren’t we going to pick up some appliance or something? How are we supposed to do that on a motorcycle?
: This ain’t just a motorcyle, man. It’s an 1,100 cc-

: Yuki, I’m going to cut you off right there as I can already tell I’m not going to understand anything you’re about to say. The moral of the story is that I’m not riding that. The end. See you later.
: What happened to showin’ me how much of a man you are, huh? You a little pussy ass bitch after all? Worried you’re gonna get a boo-boo?
: I’m worried I’m going to die. Not to mention how there is literally no way we’ll be able to-
: Relax, man. Ain’t nothin’ to be scared about. Been riding for almost as long as I’ve been walking. You’re safe with me.
: Plus, ain’t a way in hell I’d let anything happen to my baby.
: The disparity between how much you like your motorcycle and how much you like me is so great that I can’t even pretend to think you were referring to me as “your baby” just now.
: Uh-oh. You goin’ cougar-hunting again? Things not work out for ya at the bar after last time? There’s an easier target right inside, you know. And that one’s only a little bit older than-
: Whatever, fine. I’m not here to go “cougar hunting.” I’m here to prove my masculinity. Plus, you wouldn’t be a cougar anyway because cougars actually go after prey.
: All you do is pretend you don’t want to have sex with me.
: Oh, come on man. You know damn well I’m just fuckin’ around and I wouldn’t-
: Yeah, whatever. Let’s just do this before I change my mind.
: You sure? Cause I ain’t stoppin’ once we’re on that thing.
: I’m sure.
: Don’t have a helmet either. If we wipe out, we’re basically fucked.
: You should probably invest in a helmet if you’re going to be actively riding this thing, but yeah. I’m still in.
: I’m trusting you, though. And I will not hide the fact that I am only doing this because I think it will increase the probability of you accepting my advances.
: Luckily for you, we’re gonna have to get real close on there. Hope you don’t pop a boner just from grabbing onto my waist.
: I make no promise. Now, let’s do this.
Yuki hops onto the bike and pats the space behind her for me to come sit down.
Up until now, I’ve successfully avoided ever having to do anything like this. And while I definitely could have walked away tonight as well, I felt like I...shouldn’t for some reason.
Call it a desperate lunge forward if you will — a chance to further myself in an area I have stagnated in for no reason other than to hopefully have sex with a student’s mother.
It’s not a car.
I don’t know how it will make me feel and I don’t know how safe I will truly be.
But it’s not a car.
I tell myself that repeatedly as I sit down behind her and wrap my hands around her waist.
: Comfortable?
: It’s not...the worst.
Yuki starts slow and cruises through the neighborhood surrounding the bar at what I imagine is well below the speed limit.
The sensation of the wind in my hair, while I’m sure it’s liberating for some, feels to me as if I’m being repeatedly pelted by the fists of a half-corporeal god.
It is there and it is tangible, though it moves right through me the way an arrow would if I was any good at thinking up metaphors on the back of a metal death trap.
: Just hang in there, aight? I don’t mind if you grab me a little bit tighter.
: I know I’ve been kinda flighty in the face of your “advances” lately, but I’m willing to make an exception while we’re on my bike.
: So it’s cool if we make out now?
: Sure, so long as you want to die. I’m good, but not “ride with my eyes closed” good.
: If you wind up grabbin’ my tits on accident, though, I ain’t gonna kick the shit out of you.
: It’s not like there’s much to grab in the first place.
: Oi, only I get to mock my chest. Ain’t cool when you do it. Just sounds like you’re tryin’ to compensate for somethin’.
: Maybe I am.
: Oh yeah? That shit Yumi say the other night about you havin’ a tiny dick have any truth to it?
: Ain’t gonna hold it against you if she’s right. Ain’t cool to measure how much of a man someone is by the pistol they’re packin’.
: Oh, no. My penis is massive. But being back here does sort of emasculate me.
: Em...asculate? What’s that? That a sex thing? You ain’t gonna cum on my jacket, are you?
: For lack of a better term, it makes me feel like a bitch.
: A bitch? Nah. I don’t see it that way at all.
: A bitch would have...you know, bitched out. You’re tryin’ something new and you oughtta be respected for that.
: Even if it means hanging onto the waist of someone who is both smaller than me and a woman?
: The fuck’s bein’ a woman have to do with anything? You think you’re supposed to be bigger and stronger than me just cause you’ve got a dick? Nah.
: Maybe fifty years ago, but it don’t work like that anymore.
: I know. I’m just, and please excuse the pun, not in the backseat very often.
: So it makes me feel a little more submissive and...I guess more feminine than I’m used to. That’s what I meant by being emasculated.
: Well, I still don’t know shit about this whole “emasculated” thing, but I really ain’t all that concerned about any of that “feminine or masculine” crap at the end of the day.
: People are people, man. Why are we always assignin’ weird ass words and titles to ‘em when everybody’s different?
: You think I ever felt “feminine?” Nah. Been gettin’ shit for not bein’ girly enough my whole life. Just look at me. But like, who even gives a shit?
: Not like it makes any sorta difference when we’re all just tryin’ to get by out here.
: If the world wants to think I’m not bein’ a “real” girl cause I’m sittin’ in the front while there’s a dude in the back holdin’ onto me, the world can go fuck itself.
: All that shit’s just meant to keep us down, you know.
: Be this...Be that...Boys don’t cry...Girls play with dolls. All bullshit. If you want to cry, fuckin’ cry. You want to play with dolls? Play with fuckin’ dolls.
: Don’t feel pressured to label yourself just cause you’re doin’ somethin’ people think is weird or different. All that’ll do is a paint a fuckin’ target on your back.
: It’s like gangs, dude. Same people, same ideals — killin’ each other over fucking colors because that’s what they were told to do.
: People nowadays are so focused on bein’ a part of somethin’ that they’re missin’ out on all life has to offer.
: We gotta stop forming teams and just accept that we’re all fuckin’ weird when it really comes down to it.
: It ain’t our balls or tits that tell us how we’re supposed to be or act, its our brains and our hearts. And that shit looks the same no matter who you pull it out of. You know?
: Yeah...but I’m a little surprised you went on such a heated rant about it based on one offhand comment I made.
: I just hate people thinkin’ they’re supposed to be a certain way, you know?
: I like you cause you’re you. You don’t gotta be the fuckin’ 1950’s poster-boy for manliness. You’ve just gotta respect me and not make me feel like a piece of shit all the time. That’s all.
: Should be that way for everyone...but we all just want to hate each other now.
: I don’t know. Maybe I’m just too old for this shit and I ain’t really gettin’ it or something.
: Just know I ain’t gonna judge you for sittin’ back there. And I’d be hard pressed to think you’d judge me for sittin’ up here.
: Thank you for the motivational speech. I now no longer feel emasculated in telling you to keep your eyes on the road.
: You got it, princess. Or prince. Or whatever the fuck you want to call yourself cause they’re all the same exact fuckin’ thing. Same crown, different jewels. Feel me?
: I...don’t think that’s accurate. Nor do I even know if princes and princesses even wear crowns?
: I ain’t got a fuckin’ clue either. Just talkin’ outta my ass at this point. Feels good rantin’ to somebody for once, though.
: Ridin’ for me has always been a time to get my thoughts together. Everything always clogs up once I stop movin’, so the wind helps rattle my brain and make shit clear again.
: Ain’t sure if you’ll ever wanna do this again after tonight, but...
: Would be nice havin’ you.
: I’ve barely even said anything, Yuki...
: I know, I know.
: But the wind can get cold at night. And right now?...
: You’re keeping me warm as fuck.
: I’m going to puke.
: First ride’s always the hardest. You’ll do better on the way back.
: I’ll call us a taxi. I don’t think I can do that again.
: Ain’t gonna be able to fit Sara’s big ass espresso machine in a taxi.
: But we can fit it on a motorcycle?...
: Hell yeah we can. We’ll just ride carefully. Don’t have to worry about the roof of a car holdin’ us down. How’s your upper back strength? Need a quick massage?
: Right now is probably the only time in recent memory that I don’t want to be touched by you...or anyone, for that matter.
: Well, take a few minutes to catch your breath or whatever. But after that, we’ve gotta move our leg-hands.
: Oh no...Not you too...
: Come to think of it, you seen Kaori lately? Cause she’s been actin’ weird as shit the last few times I’ve called her.
: Is she ever...not weird?...
: Like...weird by even her standards. Which is probably hard to understand, but...I don’t know. Just keep an eye out for her, I guess.
: Worried all those jobs she has might finally be catchin’ up with her. Don’t want her burnin’ out.
: I’ll see what I can do...
After a few minutes go by and I’m still no better than when I first got off the bike, Yuki gets tired of waiting and drags me by the arm toward a restaurant supply store.
As it turns out, a normal espresso machine (Which, might I add, is not a thing a bar even needs) just wasn’t going to cut it and Sara felt compelled to order the deluxe one instead.
And while I am in no physical or mental state to question this [[horrible] business decision of hers, I will say that it’s good to see she’s at least trying to do something.
What is not good, however, is that it now falls on Yuki and me to get this thing all the way back to the bar...
And it is very heavy.
Yuki’s affection has increased to [yuki_love]!
